title: The Queen Who Ruled Without a King

segments.text: Eleanor of Aquitaine was one of the most powerful women.
She married two kings and ruled two countries.
Eleanor was a key player in the Crusades.
At times, she even led her own armies into battle.
Her influence stretched from France to England.
Eleanor's legacy shaped European politics for generations.
Eleanor of Aquitaine was one of the most powerful women.
Follow for history they never taught you.

description: Uncover the incredible story of Eleanor, a queen who ruled on her own terms. Follow for daily history!
